title: PBA: Phoenix coach challenges import to play better after 'bad' Game 1

blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Coach Charles Tiu didn’t mince words when it comes to the way import Marcellus Earlington performed in Phoenix’s Game 1 loss to NLEX in the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Sunday here. Earlington scored 14 points but on 6-of-19 from the field, on top of 13 rebounds while turning the ball over six times in the 97-92 defeat that put the Fuel Masters behind to open the best-of-five series.
